content.value_statement: TypeScript pull requests can miss project-specific frontend rules and review priorities. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to review Metabase changes with consistent standards.
actual_capabilities: Reviews TypeScript and JavaScript diffs against Metabase frontend standards.
Prioritizes no-any rules, type modeling, null handling, naming, and structure.
Checks pull requests for accessibility, performance, security, bundle size, and analytics concerns.
Guides reviewers to rank findings by project-specific severity.
Uses linked Metabase standards as the primary review baseline when available.
limitations: Requires the referenced Metabase standards files to be available for full context.
Does not run tests or type checks unless the agent uses separate tools.
Focuses on Metabase conventions, which may not fit other projects.
Cannot prove runtime behavior without the full application context.

use_cases.title: Pull Request Review
use_cases.description: Review frontend changes before merge and identify standards violations with clear priority.

use_cases.title: Type Safety Audit
use_cases.description: Find type modeling issues, any usage, and null handling problems in changed files.

use_cases.title: Feature Quality Check
use_cases.description: Check new user flows for accessibility, analytics, performance, and test coverage gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Basic PR Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a first pass on a small TypeScript pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this TypeScript pull request with the typescript-review skill. Focus on clear standards violations and missing tests.

prompt_templates.title: Type Safety Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when the change touches data models, APIs, or state handling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these changes for Metabase TypeScript standards. Prioritize any usage, weak type modeling, and null or undefined handling.

prompt_templates.title: Frontend Quality Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for React changes that affect users directly.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this frontend change for accessibility, performance, analytics, bundle size, and maintainability concerns. Rank findings by impact.

prompt_templates.title: Comprehensive Release Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before merging a larger feature branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full Metabase TypeScript review of this diff. Include blocking issues, nonblocking concerns, test gaps, and questions for the author.

output_examples.input: A pull request adds a React modal and updates state handling for a dashboard flow.
output: Blocking: The new state path can produce an untyped value in the modal props.
Accessibility: The modal needs keyboard focus management and an accessible name.
Question: Should this new dashboard flow emit an analytics event?

output_examples.input: A diff imports a large utility package and changes a frequently rendered component.
output: Performance: The component creates new object values on each render path.
Bundle size: Consider a targeted import instead of loading the full utility package.
Tests: Add coverage for the changed rendering branch.

output_examples.input: A small TypeScript refactor changes null handling around API response data.
output: Type safety: Model the absent response field directly instead of relying on broad optional values.
Maintainability: Keep the guard close to the data transformation step.
No accessibility or analytics concerns were found in this diff.

best_practices: Provide the pull request diff and any related Metabase standards files.
Ask for severity ranking so blocking issues are easy to separate from suggestions.
Run type checks and tests separately when the review identifies risky changes.
anti_patterns: Using the skill as a replacement for TypeScript compiler checks.
Applying Metabase-specific rules unchanged to unrelated repositories.
Ignoring nonblocking findings that affect accessibility, analytics, or long-term maintenance.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews TypeScript and JavaScript changes against Metabase frontend standards and review priorities.

faq.question: Does it execute code?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides review guidance. Agents may use separate allowed tools to inspect files or run checks.

faq.question: Can it review non-Metabase projects?
faq.answer: It can help, but its recommendations are tuned for Metabase conventions and may need adaptation.

faq.question: Does it check accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks reviewers to flag keyboard support, focus handling, labels, and semantic interaction issues.

faq.question: Does it find security issues?
faq.answer: It prompts reviewers to consider security in new frontend code, but it is not a dedicated security scanner.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the pull request diff, changed files, related tests, and referenced Metabase standards when available.
